title: Prompt-Settlement Allowance on Home-Visit Service Charges
content:
## Allowance schedule — Specimen Collection Appointments, Mobile In-Home Collection Visit

A settlement of the service charges of a collected home visit carries a prompt-settlement allowance that depends on the days to settlement (the calendar days counted up to today for the visit's charges) and on the patient's test invoices in Patient Invoices & Statements — whether any of them is placed with the collection agency (an invoice in collections status).

| Days to settlement | Any of the patient's test invoices placed with the collection agency? | Prompt-settlement allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 10 or fewer | No | 5 percent |
| 11 to 30 | No | 2 percent |
| More than 30 | No | None |
| Any | Yes | None |

**Clause.** When the days to settlement are 10 or fewer and none of the patient's test invoices is placed with the collection agency, the allowance is 5 percent; when the days to settlement are 11 to 30 and none of the patient's test invoices is placed with the collection agency, it is 2 percent; otherwise there is no prompt-settlement allowance.

### Edges (hypothetical settlements, no invoice in collections)

- 10 days: 5 percent. 11 days: 2 percent.
- 30 days: 2 percent. 31 days: none.
- 4 days, but one of the patient's invoices is with the collection agency: none.
